simple.meaning: בֶּלַע (belaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a gulp ; figuratively, destruction.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֶּלַע (H1105) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 52:6, with occurrences in Psalms, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֶּלַע (H1105) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֶּלַע (H1105) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֶּלַע (belaʻ) / H1105 is traced through Psalms 52:6, Jeremiah 51:44 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.usage: devouring, that which he hath swallowed up.
definitions.full: H1105. bela I. בֶּ֫לַע noun [masculine] swallowing, devouring, thing swallowed . 1 swallowing = destruction , דִּבְרֵיבָֿ֑לַע Psa 52:6 devouring words (|| מִרְמָה לְשׁוֺן ). 2 thing swallowed בִּלְעוֺ , Jer 51:44 מִמִּיו אתבֿ ׳וְהֹצֵאתִי and I will bring forth that which he hath swallowed out of his mouth.
